rules.quote: In `2026-10-21`, responses from the Admin API and the [Claude Enterprise Analytics API](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/manage-claude/analytics-api) no longer include the old names of renamed fields.
rules.summary: Calls the Admin or Enterprise Analytics API, whose responses on 2026-10-21 rename `roles` to `role_ids`, `group_id` to `rbac_group_id`, `name` to `display_name` (RBAC roles), `group_type` to `group.type`, `actor.email` to `actor.email_address` and `summaries` to `data`, and replace `workspace_id` on API keys with `scope`. Refit cannot yet tie each read to its endpoint, so the reads are listed for review.

rules.quote: the beta Messages type `BetaSkill` (the container Skill reference) is renamed `BetaContainerSkill`.
rules.summary: Names the `BetaSkill` type, renamed `BetaContainerSkill`; `client.beta.files` and `client.beta.skills` now return the same shapes as `client.files` and `client.skills` (TypeScript SDK 0.122.0).
